name: boligmcp
description: Public Danish property data for an address: BBR, Matriklen, public valuation, plans, site conditions and investor flags.

datafordeler_api_key.title: Datafordeleren API key (your own)
datafordeler_api_key.description: Free. Create a web user at datafordeler.dk, add an IT-system with API-key authentication and paste its key here. Unlocks BBR, Matriklen, valuations, DAR and DAGI. Without it only plans, environment and statistics work.

datafordeler_oauth_client_id.title: Datafordeler OAuth Client ID (optional)
datafordeler_oauth_client_id.description: Only for sale prices (EJF), after Geodatastyrelsen approves your request.

datafordeler_oauth_client_secret.title: Datafordeler OAuth Shared Secret (optional)
datafordeler_oauth_client_secret.description: Together with the Client ID. Not an API key.

emodata_user.title: EMOData username (optional)
emodata_user.description: Needs your own agreement with Energistyrelsen. Unlocks energy labels.

emodata_password.title: EMOData password (optional)
emodata_password.description: Your own EMOData password, together with the username.

dataforsyningen_token.title: Dataforsyningen token (optional)
dataforsyningen_token.description: Not used by the core tools yet.
